sentences.text: Mira, an 8-year-old spayed Domestic Shorthair, refused every z/d feeding from Jun 5 to 19, 30 in a row, with 34 of 38 rated feedings refused from Jun 1 to 19, and the trial was stopped on day 19.
Weight was −6.8% in 18 days, 4.4 kg on Jun 1 to 4.1 kg on Jun 19, from 2 home-scale readings.
A free-fed Purina ONE Indoor Advantage bowl was down, with intake not directly observed, and what she ate from it is unknown.
The owner-entered diet trial of Hill's z/d, hydrolysed chicken liver, was stopped on day 19 of 42.
Vomiting was entered on 5 of 19 logged days; there is nothing logged after Jun 19, which is 13 days before this report.
